identity.name: Journal of Sport and Health Science
identity.publisher: Elsevier B.V. (co-published with KeAi Communications; owned by Shanghai University of Sport)
identity.source_note: Live ScienceDirect/Elsevier guide-for-authors returned HTTP 403 (bot-blocked); web.archive.org was unreachable from this environment and reader proxies (r.jina.ai) were auth-gated, so no usable snapshot URL could be obtained. Values were encoded from WebSearch-surfaced verbatim guide quotes plus the journal's official EndNote reference-style page (https://endnote.com/downloads/styles/journal-of-sport-and-health-science/). Live guide URL bot-blocked: https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-sport-and-health-science/publish/guide-for-authors

encoding_notes: Live guide bot-blocked (ScienceDirect 403); Wayback unreachable and proxies auth-gated. Encoded from WebSearch-surfaced verbatim guide quotes + the journal's official EndNote style page. Treat as TIER_B (blocked).

Journal accepts: Research highlight, Commentary, Opinion, Review, Original article, Letter to the editor. Mapped Original article->original_research, Review->review, Letter to the editor->letter. OMITTED (no clean enum slot): Research highlight, Commentary, Opinion.

Commentary cap (not in article_types): <=1000 words, 1 display item, <=20 references. Opinion cap (not in article_types): 1500-2500 words, <=25 references. Captured here since they cannot be word_limits keys.
original_research display-item rule is a COMBINED cap: 'no more than 6 display items (tables and/or figures)'. Schema has separate figures_max/tables_max so both left null; do not enforce 6 per type.
review word cap 6000 is 'including abstract but excluding references, tables, and figures'; encoded as manuscript_max_words with abstract_max_words null.
Peer review is SINGLE-blind per the journal (double_blind=false). Some secondary sources claimed double-blind; the journal's own guide states single-blind.

References: Elsevier 'Vancouver Numbered / Non-superscripted Number' style, appearance-order (order=cited). in_text left null: EndNote confirms non-superscript numbering but does not definitively state bracket vs parenthesis; journal_abbrev/DOI/et_al unverified from reachable sources.
Keywords 3-5 attributed to JSHS by search ('invited to submit 3-5 keywords'); required=false because wording is 'invited', not mandatory. Medium confidence.

Figures: 'figures should additionally be uploaded as high resolution files' -> separate_files=true; no explicit format list or DPI number given (min_dpi null, formats []). Tables/figures 'may be presented with captions within the main body' -> placement/legends in_text.

Data statement is required at submission ('The statement will appear with your published article on ScienceDirect') -> declarations.required includes data_availability; full declarations order not verifiable from reachable text (order []).

layout (font, size, spacing, margins, page size, line numbers, alignment) NOT specified in reachable text; Elsevier's guide typically imposes no strict formatting -> all null (line_numbers 'none' as enum has no null). Title-page element list, ORCID, cover-letter, highlights, submission system all unverifiable -> null/false conservative.
ISSN 2095-2546. Publisher verified as Elsevier co-published with KeAi (owner Shanghai University of Sport); no publisher migration found.
[schema-required default] references.in_text defaulted to 'bracket' (guide did not state the in-text citation marker; schema requires a value; inferred from reference style 'vancouver').
[schema-required default] references.journal_abbrev defaulted to 'nlm' (guide silent; NLM/Index Medicus abbreviations assumed).
2026-07-18 doctrine audit: line_numbers 'none' was a default, not a guide statement — nulled so the engine preserves the author's setting.
